name: Bite Your Tongue
source:
You can’t control what happens to you, but you can control how you react. How far will you go to protect the secret you want to forget?

Your secret has fallen into the wrong hands, and now you're forced to obey a mysterious blackmailer's demands again and again.

However, their requests keep on getting worse... Can you go against your instinct to run from your problems?

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/bite-your-tongue]itch.io[/url]]
